rows.question: Is there an official source for betting lines (opening and closing prices)?
rows.known_answer: Not found. None of the official pages read this round shows a betting line, and every market_* field in the price store is null (RF-17).
rows.gap: An official or owner-approved price source (decision SG-01). Options are in suggestion S-02.
rows.how_to_discover: Owner decision. Search nfl.com terms and data-licence pages for any price feed before choosing.

rows.question: How many completed 2026 regular-season games are there?
rows.how_to_discover: Re-read the standings each week and recompute sum(W+L+T)/2 (engine/round2.py).

rows.known_answer: All 136 Weeks 1-9 games reconcile to official standings for 32 of 32 clubs. 1 of 14 Week-10 finals is present (RC-11, RC-12).

rows.question: Does a 'Questionable' designation predict that a player plays?
rows.known_answer: Not measured. Round 1 joined one Sunday's report to the inactive list (n and Wilson intervals on the Verification page). That is one week, not a rate.
rows.gap: Play rate per designation across several seasons, with confidence intervals (E14, E21).

rows.question: Is there an official depth-chart source for all 32 clubs?
rows.known_answer: Not established. The league route is closed (404). Per the depth-sweep namespace (not re-read here), 31 club pages are text and Houston publishes an image.
rows.gap: A machine-readable Houston depth surface, or an authorised structured source (E13).
rows.how_to_discover: Owner decision on an authorised source. Transcribing an image by eye is not allowed by the brief.

rows.question: Do official NFL Game Books contain snap counts, so that starters can be measured?
rows.known_answer: Not verified. Round 1 recorded that the Game Book route is reachable; the contents were not checked against snap counts.
rows.gap: Confirmation that a Game Book lists snaps per player, and coverage for all 32 clubs (E06, A05).
rows.how_to_discover: Open one official Game Book PDF for a completed game and read it line by line.

rows.question: How large a sample do the leaderboard gates need?
